cases.sentence: В десятом месяце девятого года правления Цедекии царя Иудеи, Навуходоносор, царь Вавилона, двинулся на _____.
cases.translation: In the tenth month of the ninth year of Zedekiah's reign, Nebuchadnezzar, king of Babylon, marched against Jerusalem.
cases.explain: The verb 'двинулся' (marched) with the preposition 'на' (against/to) requires the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Когда Иерусалим был взят, все сановники царя Вавилона вошли и сели у средних _____.
cases.translation: When Jerusalem was taken, all the officials of the king of Babylon came in and sat in the middle gates.
cases.explain: The preposition 'у' (at) when referring to location requires the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Они вышли из города ночью по дороге царского сада через ворота между двумя стенами и направились к _____.
cases.translation: They went out of the city at night by the way of the king's garden, through the gate between the two walls, and went toward the valley.
cases.explain: The preposition 'к' (toward) requires the dative case, but here we need the directional sense requiring accusative after directional verbs with certain prepositions. Actually, 'к' takes dative: долине. Let me reconsider - направились к долине uses дательный (dative). Correcting: долине (dative).

cases.sentence: Они вышли из города ночью по дороге царского сада через ворота между двумя стенами и направились к Иорданской _____.
cases.translation: They went out of the city at night by the way of the king's garden, through the gate between the two walls, and went toward the Jordan valley.
cases.explain: The preposition 'к' (toward/to) requires the dative case.

cases.sentence: Но халдийское войско пустилось за ними в погоню и настигло Цедекию на равнинах у _____.
cases.translation: But the Chaldean army pursued them and overtook Zedekiah on the plains of Jericho.
cases.explain: The preposition 'у' (at/near) requires the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Они схватили его и привели его к Навахудоносору, царю Вавилона, в Ривлу, что в земле _____.
cases.translation: They took him and brought him to Nebuchadnezzar, king of Babylon, to Riblah in the land of Hamath.
cases.explain: The preposition 'в' (in) when indicating location with proper nouns sometimes takes genitive, but typically takes prepositional case. Here, 'земле Хамата' uses the genitive form as a construct. The preposition phrase 'в земле' (in the land) uses prepositional case for земле, and 'Хамата' (of Hamath) is in genitive as the genitive modifier.

cases.sentence: После этого он выколол Цедекии глаза и заковал его в бронзовые ___, чтобы увезти его в Вавилон.
cases.translation: He put out Zedekiah's eyes and bound him in bronze fetters to carry him to Babylon.
cases.explain: The verb 'заковал' (bound/chained) requires the accusative case for its direct object.

cases.sentence: Невузардан, начальник царской охраны, угнал в плен Вавилон людей, которые еще оставались в _____.
cases.translation: Nebuzaradan, the captain of the guard, carried away captive into Babylon the people who remained in the city.
cases.explain: The preposition 'в' (in) when indicating location requires the prepositional case.

cases.sentence: Но Невузардан оставил в земле Иудеи часть бедняков, у которых ничего не было, и дал им ___ и поля.
cases.translation: But Nebuzaradan left in the land of Judah some of the poorest people, who had nothing, and gave them vineyards and fields.
cases.explain: The verb 'дал' (gave) requires the accusative case for its direct object.

reading.ru: В десятом месяце девятого года правления Цедекии царя Иудеи, Навуходоносор, царь Вавилона, двинулся на Иерусалим со всем своим войском и взял его в осаду.
reading.question: When did Nebuchadnezzar march against Jerusalem?
options: In the tenth month of the ninth year of Zedekiah's reign
In the ninth month of the tenth year of Zedekiah's reign
In the seventh month of the eighth year of Zedekiah's reign
In the eleventh month of the eleventh year of Zedekiah's reign
reading.correct: In the tenth month of the ninth year of Zedekiah's reign
reading.explain: The text states 'В десятом месяце девятого года правления Цедекии' — in the tenth month of the ninth year of Zedekiah's reign.

reading.ru: На девятый день четвертого месяца одиннадцатого года правления Цедекии в городской стене была пробита брешь.
reading.question: When was a breach made in the city wall?
options: On the ninth day of the fourth month of the eleventh year of Zedekiah's reign
On the fourth day of the ninth month of the tenth year
On the twelfth day of the fifth month of the eleventh year
On the first day of the first month of the ninth year
reading.correct: On the ninth day of the fourth month of the eleventh year of Zedekiah's reign
reading.explain: The text states 'На девятый день четвертого месяца одиннадцатого года правления Цедекии в городской стене была пробита брешь'.

reading.ru: Когда Иерусалим был взят, все сановники царя Вавилона вошли и сели у средних ворот.
reading.question: What did the officials of the king of Babylon do when Jerusalem was taken?
options: They came in and sat in the middle gate
They burned the city and left immediately
They took prisoners and went back to Babylon
They fortified the walls and prepared for defense
reading.correct: They came in and sat in the middle gate
reading.explain: The text says 'все сановники царя Вавилона вошли и сели у средних ворот' — all the officials of the king of Babylon came in and sat in the middle gate.

reading.ru: Но халдийское войско пустилось за ними в погоню и настигло Цедекию на равнинах у Иерихона.
reading.question: What happened to Zedekiah when the Chaldean army pursued him?
options: They overtook him on the plains of Jericho
He escaped to Egypt and was never found
He was killed at the gates of Jerusalem
He hid in the desert for forty days
reading.correct: They overtook him on the plains of Jericho
reading.explain: The text states 'халдийское войско пустилось за ними в погоню и настигло Цедекию на равнинах у Иерихона'.

reading.ru: После этого он выколол Цедекии глаза и заковал его в бронзовые кандалы, чтобы увезти в Вавилон.
reading.question: What did the king of Babylon do to Zedekiah after the judgment?
options: He put out his eyes and bound him in bronze fetters to carry him to Babylon
He set him free and gave him honor
He made him a governor over a province
He executed him immediately in Riblah
reading.correct: He put out his eyes and bound him in bronze fetters to carry him to Babylon
reading.explain: The text describes 'выколол Цедекии глаза и заковал его в бронзовые кандалы, чтобы увезти в Вавилон'.

reading.ru: Но Невузардан оставил в земле Иудеи часть бедняков, у которых ничего не было, и дал им виноградники и поля.
reading.question: What did Nebuzaradan do for the poor of Judah?
options: He left some of the poorest people in the land and gave them vineyards and fields
He took all the poor away to Babylon as slaves
He destroyed all the vineyards and fields
He divided the land equally among all remaining people
reading.correct: He left some of the poorest people in the land and gave them vineyards and fields
reading.explain: The text states 'Невузардан оставил в земле Иудеи часть бедняков, у которых ничего не было, и дал им виноградники и поля'.
